subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Is the current redacted predicate-script transcript sufficient real behavior proof for this retry/session change, or should merge wait for a full-runner or gateway run?
rationale: The patch shape is reasonable, but this external PR changes retry behavior across session state and message delivery, and the visible proof still does not exercise the full product path that users hit.

options.title: Require full-runner or gateway proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, gateway logs, or an artifact showing the retry warning, recovered response, and no duplicate delivery/tool side effects after the branch is rebased.

options.title: Accept extracted proof
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the temporary-script and fault-injected test proof while owning the remaining runtime-path risk.

options.title: Pause for a different contract
options.body: If the optional attempt-result field is not the desired harness contract, pause this branch and request a different same-attempt side-effect signal.

recommendation.title: Require full-runner or gateway proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, gateway logs, or an artifact showing the retry warning, recovered response, and no duplicate delivery/tool side effects after the branch is rebased.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the embedded runner, terminal classification, and bundled Codex harness compatibility surfaces touched by the decision.
